# EduBlocks

> EduBlocks is a free, drag-and-drop block-based coding platform by Anaconda that teaches Python and web development to beginners through visual programming.

EduBlocks combines block-based coding with Python education, offering both an interactive platform and comprehensive curriculum for students and teachers. The platform supports multiple hardware platforms including Raspberry Pi and micro:bit, making it ideal for hands-on computer science education.

## Key Topics

- block-based coding
- Python education
- drag-and-drop interface

- beginner programming

## Getting Started

- [EduBlocks](https://edublocks.org): Free drag-and-drop block-based coding tool by Anaconda for learning Python and HTML
- [Welcome to the EduBlocks docs](https://docs.edublocks.org): Documentation hub with guides for EduBlocks features, setup, and developer documentation

## Curriculum & Learning

- [EduBlocks Curriculum](https://curriculum.edublocks.org): Free Python curriculum with Scratch-to-Python lessons and Turtle graphics learning paths

## Classroom & Teaching

- [Classrooms for Teachers](https://docs.edublocks.org/docs/classrooms/for-teachers): Teacher guide for creating classrooms, assignments, and providing student feedback in EduBlocks
